fixes.explanation: It's true, friend. The LORD says, “Nor should you stand at the crossroads to cut off their fugitives, nor deliver up their survivors in the day of their distress.” (Obadiah 1:14). Standing at the crossroads to cut off fugitives is on the list of things the LORD says Edom should not do. The fugitives are the people of Judah, the ones trying to get away. So this one is True.
